Layout cell one holds prose, not data, with enough words to be a paragraph of its own.

Layout cell two holds more prose that should read as ordinary text.

Tables carry data that the converter must keep aligned, so this paragraph supplies enough words for the extractor to treat the page as an article rather than boilerplate.
